reuse.why: expectedAmount is computed by the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, single and ranged amounts with the furthest-from-zero rule.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-written; the field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, where the API's schedule shape is mapped, and the type is extended next to it.

scope.why: Only the API model, its type, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule in getScheduledAmount flows to the API automatically; the output-only nature of the field is documented on the type.
